bio_md:
# 宋帝昺 · 主要事迹

赵昺为[[s-song-du|度宗]]之子，卫王。景炎三年（1278）[[s-song-duan|端宗]]崩于硇洲后，张世杰、陆秀夫奉昺即位，改元祥兴，驻崖山（今广东新会）。

祥兴二年（1279）元将张弘范攻崖山，宋军大败；陆秀夫负帝昺投海，后宫女眷、将士殉国者十数万，宋祚遂绝。自太祖建隆元年（960）至此，两宋三百二十年。崖山云低，海波如墨，一个时代的文化记忆自此沉入南溟。

died at Naozhou in 1278, Zhang Shijie and Lu Xiufu enthroned Bing, era Xiangxing, stationed at Yashan (modern Xinhui, Guangdong).

In 1279 the Yuan general Zhang Hongfan attacked Yashan; the Song fleet was annihilated. Lu Xiufu carried the child emperor into the sea, and tens of thousands followed into death. The Song perished - 320 years from Taizu's founding in 960. Under the low clouds of Yashan, a civilization's memory sank into the southern sea.
